label: hADSCs
notes: hADSCs (human adult adipose-derived mesenchymal stromal cells) are the trajectory starting point. PRIMARY ASSIGNMENT: source sample identity / time == 0 (ADSC starting sample), following the treatment in Liuyang et al. 2023 (Cell Stem Cell, DOI: 10.1016/j.stem.2023.02.008). This gene set is an AUXILIARY somatic/fibroblast-like support score only; do not use it as the primary classifier. Generic MSC surface markers (THY1, NT5E, ENG) are intentionally excluded from this set.
